scientific_hypothesis: Same-sequence measured HepG2 MRL is a paired cross-cell experimental anchor that can improve real T-cell MRL selection relative to frozen Sample-CNN scores; no residual or other-sequence correction model is fitted.
evidence_boundary: Paired cross-cell retrospective evidence only. HepG2 measurements are not T-cell labels, but the same sequences are used in both cells. Historical outer results were previously inspected; this is neither sequence-independent validation nor a new blind/prospective test.

eligibility.definition: Exact sequence shared by T-cell r1, T-cell r2 and defined-end HepG2 r1 with finite measured HepG2 MRL; T-cell rl is not read during preparation.
eligibility.sample_exclusion: Exclude exact or Hamming-distance-1 match to any Sample train/dev/calibration utr50.
eligibility.pool_h1_rule: Sort eligible sequences by SHA256('tcell_cross_cell_anchor_v1|sequence'); greedily retain a sequence only if it has no exact/H1 match to any previously retained sequence. Stop after 1024; fail if exhausted. This guarantees no exact/H1 within or between pools.

pools.assignment: Consecutive blocks of 64 in the frozen hash-sorted, H1-isolated retained list.
pools.repeat_linkage: Exactly the same sequence and pool membership for r1 and r2.
pools.pool_manifest_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of sequence-order array file and proposal array file

methods.cnn: Frozen three-member Sample CNN arithmetic mean in measured-MRL units; no fitting.
methods.hepg2_anchor: Measured same-sequence HepG2 MRL used directly as the BoN score.
methods.rank_fusion_50_50: Secondary preregistered method: for each full 64-sequence pool, compute average-tie percentile ranks separately for CNN and HepG2, with best=1 and worst=0; score=(CNN_rank+HepG2_rank)/2. Weights fixed at 50/50 before results.
methods.random: Random(N) selects the first position of the same nested proposal prefix used by all scored methods; proposal positions are iid uniform with replacement.

selection.proposal_rule: Python random.Random('tcell_cross_cell_anchor_v1|pool_index|seed'), floor(random()*64) at each of 16 nested draws.
selection.regret: Full 64-sequence pool maximum measured T-cell MRL minus selected measured T-cell MRL
selection.effect_sign: HepG2-anchor regret minus Sample-CNN regret; negative is improvement

primary_success.bootstrap_unit: One of 16 repeat-linked pools; both repeats and all five proposal seeds move together.
primary_success.ci: Two-sided 95% percentile interval of combined anchor-minus-CNN regret; upper bound strictly below 0.
primary_success.minimum_absolute_reduction: max(0.1 MRL, 5% of combined cap16 CNN mean regret)

multiplicity.family: Ten repeat-specific anchor-minus-CNN cap effects: r1/r2 at caps 1/2/4/8/16.
multiplicity.method: Holm step-down adjustment of two-sided sign-style pool-bootstrap p-values; max monotonicity enforcement.
multiplicity.note: All five caps are reported. Holm supports secondary cap-wise inference and does not replace the combined primary gate.

secondary.spearman: For each repeat and predictor (CNN, HepG2), overall 1024-sequence average-tie Spearman and median/range of 16 within-pool Spearman coefficients. This is descriptive cross-cell association, not target-label training.
secondary.top_tail: Per full pool: CNN-vs-HepG2 top1 flip count, top16 membership Jaccard, and within-CNN-top16 nontied predictor-order flips; for flips with nontied T-cell order, counts favoring HepG2 versus CNN.
secondary.turnover: For every cap/repeat, changed BoN selections decomposed into improved, worsened and unchanged-T-cell-label counts plus mean selected-MRL change.
secondary.oracle_opportunity_loss: Best T-cell MRL among unique proposed candidates minus selected T-cell MRL; proposal headroom is full-pool best minus proposal best; their sum equals full-pool regret.
secondary.fusion: Descriptive cap-wise effects and cap16 repeat-linked bootstrap; no fusion success claim or weight adjustment.

verification_rounds: Round 1: raw hashes, label-blind preparation audit, eligible/isolation, CUDA, focused tests and prefreeze hashes.
Round 2: standalone re-reader independently recomputes all selections, primary and secondary aggregate statistics without importing anchor.py/evaluate.py.
Round 3: clean-process tests, deterministic replay/hash checks, one-evaluation audit and local forbidden-export scan.
local_export: Aggregate metrics, configs, code, logs and verification only; no sequence strings, per-sequence labels/predictions or raw data.
